description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maththumagala, Wattala D/S/Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512018 (24/0592)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels of land in specific locations. The content includes detailed land parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (all stating "The State"), and classification of title. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registration and property ownership matters.
